ANCESTRY.value: compress(1) (1984-85, Spencer Thomas, Jim McKie, Steve Davies, Ken Turkowski, James Woods, Joe Orost): adaptive LZW dictionary coding, the 4.3BSD/Unix standard before gzip; ncompress is the maintained continuation of the same code

cut.note: adaptive LZW as Unix compress did it: a dictionary maps a (prefix code, next byte) pair to a new code, built greedily as the input is read; codes start at 9 bits and widen up to maxbits as the dictionary fills; when the dictionary is full the coder does not simply stop adding entries but watches the compression ratio, and when the ratio stops improving it emits a CLEAR code and rebuilds the dictionary from scratch, so a stream whose statistics drift is re-learned rather than coded against a stale table

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: the compress loop (1258-1430): fcode.e = (ent, c); free_ent from FIRST; extcode = MAXCODE(n_bits); when free_ent >= extcode and n_bits < maxbits widen n_bits and recompute extcode with the bit-boundary alignment of the output
organs.mechanism: the current match is a code 'ent'; the next byte c forms the pair (ent, c); if that pair is in the hash table the match extends (ent becomes the pair's code), else the code for ent is emitted, the pair is added as the next free entry, and ent restarts at c; output codes are packed at the current bit width, which starts at 9 (INIT_BITS) and increases by one whenever the next free entry would exceed the current width's range, up to maxbits; a bit-boundary realignment keeps the packed stream decodable across width changes
assumptions: a greedy longest-prefix match against a growing dictionary captures repetition; widening the code only as needed keeps early output small
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the Unix standard compressor before gzip; single-pass, adaptive, no explicit model
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: once the dictionary is full and not reset it codes new data against a stale table (the failure the ratio reset addresses); the LZW patent is why gzip replaced it, not a technical failure
organs.human_prior: Ziv & Lempel 1978 (LZ78); Welch 1984 (LZW); Thomas et al. 1985 (compress)

organs.human_name: the checkpoint block (1299-1340): CHECK_GAP 10000; once stcode is off (table full) and bytes_in crosses checkpoint, compute rat = bytes_in / (bytes_out >> 8); if rat >= ratio keep, else emit CLEAR (256), reset free_ent to FIRST and ratio to 0; BLOCK_MODE bit in the header
organs.mechanism: when the dictionary is full the coder stops adding entries (stcode off) and every CHECK_GAP input bytes computes the running compression ratio using integer arithmetic (a deliberate design note: no floating point); if the ratio has not improved since the last checkpoint the dictionary is discarded via a CLEAR code and rebuilt from the single-byte entries, so the coder adapts to a change in the input's statistics; the header's BLOCK_MODE bit tells the decoder that CLEAR codes may appear
organs.output: a CLEAR code and a dictionary reset when warranted
assumptions: a falling ratio means the current dictionary no longer fits the data, so rebuilding beats coding against it; integer ratio arithmetic is exact and fast
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: a single-pass adaptive coder that recovers when the input changes character partway through
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the CHECK_GAP and the ratio comparison are heuristics; a slowly drifting stream may reset too late or too often
organs.human_prior: the compress(1) block-compress extension (the record credits the 1985 authors)

pressures.source_evidence: compress.c the LZW loop and the checkpoint block
pressures.condition: an organism compresses a stream it sees once, with a fixed maximum dictionary size; the input's character may change (text then binary); the score is compressed size and single-pass, integer-only operation
pressures.resource_or_constraint: a dictionary of 2^maxbits entries; integer arithmetic
pressures.failure_condition: coding a changed input against a stale full dictionary (ratio collapse), or needing a second pass
pressures.world_punishes: freezing the dictionary when full; a static model
pressures.world_rewards: widening codes as the table fills and clearing it when the ratio stops improving
pressures.observable_consequence: compressed size on a concatenation of two differently-distributed halves for the freeze-when-full variant vs the ratio-reset variant; ratio over position
pressures.vacuity_condition: a stationary stream that fits the dictionary
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a two-pass modeller (which the single-pass requirement forbids)
pressures.cheat_control: a two-pass optimal coder bounds the size; the freeze-when-full coder must show the ratio collapse on the second half; the ratio-reset coder must recover: the world must show all three
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: adaptive single-pass compression (Welch 1984; compress(1) 1985; ncompress continuation)
